name: custom-prompt
description: SYSTEM.md replaces the preamble; pi renders no head, so the whole text is forwarded.

toolSnippets.bash: Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)
toolSnippets.edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement

input.customPrompt:
You are Widget's release assistant.

Be precise.

contextFiles.content:

- Run `bun test` before committing.
- Never edit generated files under `dist/`.

    <name>release</name>
